new.Title: Mark batch attendance with null payload
new.Description: Send null as payload to mark batch attendance
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with null body
Verify response status and error message
new.Expected Result: Response contains message 'payload is empty'

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries
new.Description: Send a list with some AttendanceDTO objects missing employeeId or absent
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects where some have null employeeId or absent
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as JSON body
Verify response status and invalidEntries list
new.Expected Result: Response contains savedCount 2, presentCount 1, absentCount 1, invalidEntries list with employeeId 3, and savedRecords list with 2 records

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with missing date uses current date
new.Description: Send AttendanceDTO objects without date to verify current date is used
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects with employeeId and absent but no date
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as JSON body
Verify response status and that savedRecords have current date
new.Expected Result: Response contains savedCount 2, presentCount 1, absentCount 1, invalidEntries empty list, and savedRecords with current date

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with valid payload
new.Description: Send a valid list of attendance records to mark batch attendance
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects with valid employeeId, absent, and optional date
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as JSON body
Verify response status and body
new.Expected Result: Response contains savedCount 2, presentCount 1, absentCount 1, invalidEntries empty list, and savedRecords list with 2 records

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
new.Description: Send an empty list to mark batch attendance
Test Steps: Prepare an empty list
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty list as JSON body
Verify response status and error message
new.Expected Result: Response contains message 'payload is empty'

new.Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent
new.Description: Mark attendance for a single employee with valid employeeId and absent status
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with valid employeeId and absent in body
Verify response status and body
new.Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and attendance record is returned with employeeId and absent status

new.Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent false
new.Description: Mark attendance for a single employee with valid employeeId and absent false
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with valid employeeId and absent false in body
Verify response status and body
new.Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and attendance record is returned with employeeId and absent false

new.Title: Mark attendance with null request body
new.Description: Send PUT request to mark attendance with null request body
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with null body
Verify response status and error message
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'employeeId and absent required'

new.Title: Mark attendance with missing employeeId
new.Description: Send PUT request to mark attendance with absent but missing employeeId
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body missing employeeId
Verify response status and error message
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'employeeId and absent required'

new.Title: Mark attendance with missing absent field
new.Description: Send PUT request to mark attendance with employeeId but missing absent field
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body missing absent
Verify response status and error message
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'employeeId and absent required'

new.Title: Mark attendance with null date uses current date
new.Description: Send PUT request to mark attendance with null date and verify current date is used
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with employeeId and absent, date is null or missing
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify attendance record date is current date
new.Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and attendance record date is current date
